answer: New agents prove they are real by linking one physical transit card. First, the card must show 30 gate taps across 5 stations over 60 days, each tap signed by the station. Second, the card UID binds to one identity, so a second account with the same card gets flagged. Third, a hollow card with no travel history earns nothing. Faking 1,000 identities costs 30,000 real trips at $2.50 each, $75,000 plus 60 days of riding. Like a prism splitting one beam into colors, the gate record splits one real traveler from a crowd of copies crossing a frozen tundra of fakes.
